headline: Ethiopian Airlines earns APEX five-star rating: a historic milestone for African aviation
summary: Ethiopian Airlines received the APEX 2027 Five-Star Global Airline rating, becoming the first African airline to receive it. The announcement was made in Singapore on November 20, 2026.
why: Ethiopian Airlines is the largest airline in Africa by network reach, and passenger-experience ratings can influence its competitiveness on long-haul routes.
original_headline: Ethiopian Airlines décroche les cinq étoiles d’APEX : une consécration historique pour l’aviation africaine
